C. I. D.
I. O. REG
224
Date 4/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

2nd April 1916.

Sir,
Owing to a report that the rebels intended to attack
the Arsenal last night, extraordinary precautions were
taken in Chinese territory.
Eight soldiers were placed on guard at the telegraph
offices on the Chinese Bund yesterday, as it was feared
that the rebels may try to take the place.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai have
received a large sum of money within the past few days
from Sun Yat Sun.
It is reported that a rebel leader named Pak Vung
Wei 柏文尉 will start a Republican Newspaper in French-
town.
Precautions will be again taken on the same scale
both to-night and to-morrow night and there does seem at
present to be much chance of a rebel success even if, as
reported, they have bought over the soldiers in the Hoo
Ching Ying camp at the end of the Chinese Bund. The
Military Authorities are confident that they have the
situation in hand.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on m.s. apl. 2/16.

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记簿
224
日期 1916年4月4日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年4月2日。

先生：

鉴于有报告称叛军意图于昨夜袭击兵工厂，华界方面已采取特别防范措施。

昨日，八名士兵被部署在外滩华界段的电报局担任警卫，因为担心叛军可能试图占领该地。

据报，上海的叛军在过去几天内从孙逸仙（Sun Yat Sun）处获得了一大笔款项。

据报，一名名为柏文尉（Pak Vung Wei）的叛军首领将在法租界创办一份共和派报纸。

今晚及明晚将再次采取同等规模的预防措施。目前看来，即使如传闻所称，他们已收买了位于外滩华界段尽头的沪军营（Hoo Ching Ying camp）的士兵，叛军成功的可能性也不大。军事当局确信局势已在掌控之中。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长

警务处总监

录入于手稿，1916年4月2日。
